errors.text_span: които са подредени по азбучен ред
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the categories on the horizontal axis are arranged in alphabetical order. In fact, they are arranged in ascending order of company size.

The description claims the bars are "unordered elements" ("неподредени елементи"), which is incorrect. The bars are clearly ordered from left to right corresponding to the increasing size of the company. This also contradicts an earlier part of the same sentence which correctly states the ordering.
